shell.title: Account management
shell.subtitle: Profile, privacy, notifications and devices — all in one place.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: This is how other users see you.
profile.avatarHint: Upload an image from your device (JPEG, PNG, WEBP or GIF, up to 5 MB).
profile.statusPlaceholder: Tell others about yourself in one line

credentials.title: Account
credentials.emailDescription: Used to sign in. Contact support to change it.
credentials.passwordDescription: We recommend changing your password from time to time.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Enter your current password and a new one — at least 8 characters.
password.savedSignedOut: Password changed. Sign in again with your new password.

errors.mustDiffer: The new password must be different

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Control who can reach you and see your profile.
privacy.whoCanMessageDescription: Direct messages from users outside the list will be hidden.
privacy.whoCanCallDescription: Incoming calls from everyone else will be declined.
privacy.showOnlineDescription: Others will see when you're online.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose delivery channels and the events you want to hear about.
notifications.pushDescription: In the browser and the mobile app.
notifications.emailDescription: Digests and important events by email.
notifications.pushBrowserDescriptionDefault: Get notifications even when the tab is closed.
notifications.pushBrowserDescriptionDenied: Allow notifications in your browser settings to enable this.
notifications.pushBlocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser.

devices.title: Camera and microphone
devices.description: Choose default devices for video and voice calls.
devices.unsupported: Your browser doesn't support selecting media devices.
devices.permissionDescription: This is needed to show your device names. Access is released right away.

errors.enumerate: Couldn't get the list of devices

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices that are currently signed in to your account.
sessions.signOutEverywhereTitle: Sign out of all other devices?
sessions.signOutEverywhereDescription: This will end {count, plural, one {# other session} other {# other sessions}}. This device stays signed in.
sessions.revokedOthers: Signed out of all other devices

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Interface theme and language. The theme applies instantly.

blocklist.title: Blocklist
blocklist.description: Blocked users can't message you, call you, or find you in search.
blocklist.emptyDescription: You haven't blocked anyone yet. You can block someone right during a call.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.deleteDescription: Your profile, friends, conversations, coins and history will be permanently deleted. This action can't be undone.
danger.dialogDescription: To confirm, type your nickname {nickname} below.
